answer: A spare key must not buy a second vote. Each applicant leases one numbered mooring on a published grid and drops a serialled anchor at logged GPS and depth. In a 12-min slack window they record 12s of local ocean ambient, then fire a 28 kHz signal from a tag on that anchor into the clerk hydrophone. Clerks post H=blake2s(addr||mooring_id||depth_cm||spectrum_root||tone_hz). Fee is 0.41 POA; a 16 POA bond lasts 12 epochs. Auditors re-ping the tag and overlay the spectrum on the grid hydrophone. A reused mooring, canned spectrum, or silent tag seizes the bond and blinds both keys for 14 epochs.
